_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 02 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the two PO Vue views (create form + detail) onto custom manifest pages. The PurchaseOrders index and supporting CRUD scaffolding live in slice 01's manifest fragment; this fragment adds the bespoke 'Create Purchase Order' form and the rich detail view that surfaces the approval chain, approval history (with timestamps) and links to related GoodsReceiptNotes + ThreeWayMatches. Registered as kind=page custom components in src/registry.js.
